versions.changelog: Optimized search keywords, added ClawHub install option, partner logos (Stellar, Circle, MasterCard)

- Initial release of Agent Card skill (asgcard) version 1.0.8.
- Enables AI agents to create, fund, and manage virtual MasterCards using USDC on Stellar via x402 protocol.
- Supports on-chain payments with verifiable proof.
- Includes tools for card creation, funding, management, and pricing queries.
- Easy setup with wallet onboarding and payment skill installation.
